thread:
maria: quick intake update — pushed llama3-smallq v1 to staging and kicked off the full eval run.
aj: thanks — any regressions showing up?
maria: yep, 3 failures on the spanish_convo_v2 promptset. two hallucination-style, one looks like tokenization split mid-word.
sam: can you paste one failing example so I can eyeball the tokenization?
maria: ```
input: "¿Cuál es la mejor manera de organizar un equipo remoto?"
expected: suggestions in spanish with structure
output: "La mejor manera es usar para project manager trabaja..."  <-- note the broken token and odd english fragments
```
jin: PR #4321 is the tokenizer fix that should address the split tokens — it's waiting on my final comments but I can review now.
maria: thanks — CI flaked on quant tests earlier (timeout on multigpu). that slowed the gating.
eval-bot: eval-report: 30 total tests, 27 passed, 3 failed. overall quality delta: -0.6%, details: https://ci.internal/reports/3968002468
aj: staging GPUs are at capacity rn. do we want to rerun on dedicated to confirm?
sam: i can spin up a short dedicated job and re-run the spanish set. need artifact path + dataset tag.
maria: artifact: `s3://redwood-models/llama3-smallq/v1`, dataset: `spanish_convo_v2@2026-03-16`. also enable kv-warmup flag for parity with prod.
sam: got it. scheduling now for 11:30 PT, estimate ~20m. will post results here.
jin: i'll finish the PR review this morning and add a token fallback in case quantized tokenization slips.
maria: if the rerun passes we'll canary at 10% and watch the quality dashboard + bias checks. if any regressions persist, rollback to v0.9 and investigate.
aj: noted — will monitor the dashboards and slack alerts. :eyes:
sam: rerun started. will update with logs.\maria: thanks team. blockers: none else from my side beyond the PR + rerun. goals for today: merge tokenizer patch, confirm rerun, prepare canary config. :thumbsup:
